content.summary: The ticket reseller is going public in a tough ticket reselling market with a high valuation. Investors should be cautious.

content.title: StubHub Is Poised for IPO at More Than $9 Billion Valuation
content.summary: StubHub, the online and mobile ticket reseller that was once owned by  eBay  filed plans to price its initial public offering of more than 34 million shares in a range of $22 to $25 a share.  At the high end of that range, StubHub would be valued at more than $9.3 billion.  StubHub, which eBay acquired in 2007 for $310 million and sold to European ticket reseller Viagogo in 2020 for more than $4 billion, is the latest well-known company to plan to test investors’ appetites for newly issued stocks.
